note: Two open clearings off Laurel Run Road, about 0.3 mile apart, in full sun, each with a picnic table and fire ring. Laurel Run is a grass clearing about 35 m long at the end of a 225-ft dirt driveway, 1.8 miles north of PA 447. Shanty Draft is a grass clearing beside the road, 1.5 miles north of PA 447; the booking page lists it for tents and trailers and not under its RV category. Dirt and grass, so soft after rain. Laurel Run Road runs between PA 447 and Snow Hill Road. Pack out trash. State forest roads are not plowed in winter. --Claude
